title: The eraser measured in blood; the referee test sealed
set_out: Measure the eraser's share in blood cells by the sealed rule (PHY-085); finish the release check; seal the referee test of the healthy baseline (PHY-084) before reading it.
open_at_turnover: Read the 58 referee libraries by the sealed rule (canary first) and score them; the website decisions (device columns, headline order); the coin decision; the day summary.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The release check
entries.what: release.yml on GitHub after the fixes of 11-12 (OTH-070).
entries.outcome: 34 of 34 pass (bbf79331), the first full pass since the report PDFs stopped building.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): the chain's own release checks

entries.title: The eraser in blood progenitors (PHY-085)
entries.what: GSE227977's six mouse bone-marrow libraries, Tet2 wild type, mutant, knockout, by the rule sealed before reading.
entries.outcome: Met: knockout over wild type 0.900 (LSK) and 0.909 (lineage-negative), sealed 0.86-0.95; TET2 alone causes 9-10 % of losses.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): eraser-removed libraries against their own wild type

entries.title: The referee prediction grid (PHY-084)
entries.what: forward_candidate.py at the two measured eraser ratios and six clustering settings, 12 GitHub runs.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): synthetic molecules with a planted truth

entries.title: The referee test sealed (PHY-084)
entries.what: GSE173787's 58 healthy controls; prediction through the meter at each cell type's clustering; bar about +/-18 %.
entries.outcome: Sealed before any library is read; the scorer passed its synthetic test.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples to be read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: The referee canaries and two read-method amendments (PHY-084)
entries.what: Three canaries of GSM5278426 at 2 million pairs: 20 blocks, 200 blocks, 2,000 blocks.
entries.outcome: The runs are stored in genome order; 20 and 200 blocks were refused by the coverage check, 2,000 passed. Amendments 1 and 2 written before any held error was computed; the check kept.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): a test of the read method

entries.title: The 58 referee libraries dispatched (PHY-084)
entries.what: GSE173787's 58 healthy controls on GitHub by the sealed rule, 2,000 blocks, 10 million pairs each.
entries.outcome: Running; scored once with referee_score.py when all have finished.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): healthy samples to be read against the M-based prediction

entries.title: IAM-A's healthy spread split by cell type
entries.what: IAM-A's held error over its baseline on its own 150 healthy samples (55 types), split into between-type and within-type spread.
entries.outcome: 81 % of the healthy spread is between cell types; one baseline for all types spans about 0.86-1.16, a baseline per type would span about 0.94-1.07 (iama_spread_split.py; exploration).
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): IAM-A's own baseline samples, decomposed

entries.title: The eraser's share by cell type sealed (PHY-086)
entries.what: Predictions written before any library is opened: TET2 knockout in LSK, CMP and GMP progenitors (GSE210026) and TET2 + TET3 in mature B cells (GSE161463); does removing the eraser bring cell types together?
entries.outcome: Sealed in DEV_ERASE_01.md; moved to Google spot machines (erase_google.sh) before any library was opened; canary running.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): eraser-removed libraries against their own controls

entries.title: IAM-A's slope from physics, step 1 (PHY-087)
entries.what: Two readings of the baseline's measured slope written before counting: mixing inside each sample, or cell type; eleven spent healthy samples recounted tile by tile.
entries.outcome: Running on Google (the first machine lost its network and was relaunched).
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): spent healthy samples, tile by tile

entries.title: The eraser's price (PHY-088)
entries.what: One erasure (TET, TDG, base excision repair) plus its restore priced in ATP from cited sources; the measured eraser share turned into a time with an independent erasure rate (Spada et al. 2020).
entries.outcome: 14-63 coins per erasure and restore (420-1,900 times Landauer's floor); erasers cause 9.5-13.6 % of losses but take 42-83 % of the record's maintenance energy; an erased mark stays unmarked about 1-6 h in most units, inside the published restore time (eraser_price.py, eraser_rate.py; exploration).
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): a desk ledger and published rates

entries.title: Four referee libraries refused at intake (PHY-084)
entries.what: The genome-coverage check refused GSM5278446 (B) and GSM5278470, GSM5278472, GSM5278476 (CD4).
entries.outcome: Their deposited runs put about 99 % of molecules on chr1 and chr2 although the block plan spans each whole run; reported, not read by another route (sealed rule); CD4 keeps 9 of 12, B 23 of 24.
entries.reference: none (not a reading against healthy): intake refusals

entries.what: Author's decisions: qubit and chip columns removed from public tables, Met-A's commissioning on the front, older material trimmed, a first section on the derivation, reading its numbers from the canon.
entries.outcome: On main (four_domains.json public_domains; build_home.py, the derivation section).

entries.title: The referee test read (PHY-084)
entries.what: 54 healthy-control blood libraries from a laboratory never read, scored once against the M-based prediction sealed before reading.
entries.outcome: Passes by the agreed standard (pull within 2 passes, 2 to 3 watch, beyond 3 a miss): CD4, CD8 and monocytes pass, B cells on watch (pull -2.45), none beyond 3. The seal's stricter wording (any type outside) reads NOT MET; both readings are kept.
